name: Alexis Ortega
bio:
Real estate became a natural path for me as a builder’s wife. Learning the industry gave me real insight into quality and what makes a house feel like home.

I serve Ascension Parish and the surrounding areas, focusing on residential real estate, new construction and investment properties. As a newer agent, I work hard, stay detail-oriented, and have a brokerage of experienced agents behind me.

When I’m not working, you’ll usually find me traveling or spending time with my family. One of the best parts of this work is seeing clients happy and confident, whether they’re buying their first home, upgrading, investing or selling.
